NEAR's agent economy, measured

NEAR's long-term case is a bet that NEAR Intents becomes the settlement layer for cross-chain money moved by software, including autonomous agents. We test the three halves of that bet separately, from public data only.

Rebuilt by node build.mjs on 2026-11-06T01:10:14.106Z (data through 2026-11-04). Claim and tests: THESIS.md; forward tests: PREREG.md; code and raw data: github.com/tenxagent/near-agent-economy.

What it means for a NEAR holder

Usage moved to NEAR Intents: it settled 82% of NEAR's DEX volume over the last 6 full months and $11.71B in the 90 days to 2026-11-04, 1.80× the 90 days before (T1, T2).

Some of that value reaches NEAR holders, through buybacks rather than protocol fees. Since the fee switch of 2026-02-23, captured Intents revenue buys NEAR on the open market. In the 90 days to 2026-11-04 that was $4.8M, 27% of Intents' fees; NEAR's gas burn added $254.1K (C1).

It is small next to the token. Annualized, captured value is $20.6M, 0.42% a year of NEAR's $4.92B market cap. Over the same months NEAR's total supply grew 2.5% a year net of burns, about $120.8M a year at $3.75; the buyback is 16% of that. The bought-back NEAR is held (2.19M NEAR in buybacks.multisignature.near), not burned. If NEAR governance's HSP-029 cut (max issuance 2.5% → 1.6% over 24 months) runs its full ramp, the same buyback would cover 25% of net issuance.

NEAR's weekly price does not move with Intents volume (r = 0.00 over 95 weeks, T4; with BTC's moves taken out, r = -0.03, p = 0.79, T4m), and agent commerce is tiny next to Intents (T7). Small tickets are not an edge case: 48% of sampled swap legs and 47% of withdrawals were under $50 (P1). Agent-size tickets into NEAR get a 1Click quote: 0–0% under $50 (T9, quotes of 2026-11-06 01:09Z).

Read as an investment case: the usage half is supported by the record so far (T1 and T2 describe the past; the forward tests F1 and F2 check it on new data), value capture exists but covers about 16% of issuance, and the agent half is still an option. The case for the token is that the captured share grows faster than supply; we would call it made when the buyback reaches half of net issuance over a 90-day window.

Model: when does the buyback reach half of new supply?

Model (`node model.mjs`, every assumption is a flag): starting from today's 16%, at the fade the data implies (Intents' growth halving about every 1.0 quarters, see below) the buyback reaches half of net issuance not within 10 years; with a slower fade, halving every 2 quarters (the default flag), in 2027-Q4 (4 quarters); with no further growth it stays at 16%; if the measured 1.80× per 90 days never fades, in 2027-Q2 (2 quarters). A scenario, not a forecast. The measured quarter-on-quarter growth went 6.3× → 5.7× → 2.3× → 0.7× → 1.1× → 1.8×; fading from the oldest quarter to the latest four implies a half-life of about 1.0 quarters, so the 2-quarter default is on the generous side. The bought-back NEAR sits in a multisig (held, not burned); `--resold` models some of it returning to market. If HSP-029 (max issuance 2.5% → 1.6% over 24 months; House of Stake vote 99.97% for, timelock until 2026-11-16; no start date set) began its ramp now: at the implied fade, in 2028-Q4 (8 quarters); at the 2-quarter default, in 2027-Q3 (3 quarters).

Coverage = NEAR bought back per year ÷ net new NEAR per year. Now 16.2%. At the fade the data implies (growth halving every 1.01 quarters): 31.8% in 4 quarters, 33.4% in 8. With the slower default flag (halving every 2 quarters): 55.1% in 4 quarters, 77.9% in 8.

growth fadebuyback share 27.1%buyback share 50.0%buyback share 100.0%
no growth– / –– / –0 / –
half-life 1 q– / –2 / –0 / 2
half-life 2 q4 / –2 / 40 / 2
half-life 4 q3 / 51 / 30 / 1
never fades2 / 41 / 30 / 1

Quarters until the buyback reaches half / all of net new supply (– = not within 10 years), NEAR price flat. Re-run with your own numbers: node model.mjs --half-life 4 --capture 0.5 --price-q 0.1 (formulas in lib/model.mjs).

Tests

T1PASSUsage

Did NEAR usage shift from counts to settled value?

Over the last 6 full months (2026-05 → 2026-10), NEAR Intents settled 82% of NEAR's DEX volume. From 2025-01 to 2026-10, NEAR's daily transactions fell 90% and its active accounts 92%, while monthly Intents volume grew 622×.

Rule: share >= 0.70 AND txns and active accounts down >= 50% AND Intents monthly volume up >= 50x (2025-01 -> last full month)

In the 90 days to 2026-11-04, $4.8M of Intents revenue bought NEAR back (27.1% of Intents' fees) and gas burn added $254.1K: $20.6M a year, 0.42% of NEAR's market cap. NEAR's supply grew 2.5% a year net of burns ($120.8M); the buyback is 16% of that. Cross-check: the buyback wallet holds 69% of the NEAR the series would have bought at daily prices (outflows not decoded).
